# SwimMark Coordinator

This key role involves being the key contact and lead volunteer who manages a 
swimming club's [SwimMark](https://www.swimming.org/swimengland/swimmark-accreditation-for-clubs/) 
accreditation process with Swim England.

SwimMark is an accreditation system, renewed every 12 months, which recognises a 
club is operating in a safe and compliant way and has achieved the minimum 
standard of safe and effective practice.

[Role profile](https://www.swimming.org/careers/swimmark-coordinator-role/)
